claim_scope: single previously unexposed Codec case; exploratory real-project repair only; not proof of general RSI
feedback_boundary: all candidate orders frozen and hashed before any tests of generated candidates
focus_selection: Codec loaded_classes/<bug>.src, limited to existing project Java sources
repair_memory_source: empty - no previously retained Codec or Lang fixes
selection_method: sha256(seed) mod count of active bugs, preserving active-bugs.csv row order
source_tree: buggy checkout only (15b), no fixed checkout
validator: Defects4J compile then full Defects4J test on isolated candidate copies
